source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Ballymoney Free Press nomination list of 1 May 1924

note: Triennial election of the twenty-one members of Coleraine rural district, one member each. Every candidate was returned unopposed and there was no contest. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Grove' to The Grove (13 Nov 2026, by the owner's rule for division spellings: the official or DED-map name where there is one, otherwise the spelling most rounds use): the DED maps of 1921-69 (THE GROVE) spell it The Grove. This round was filed under the spelling 'Grove', a form of the division's name it keeps as an alias; the old address (grove) answers with a redirect to this one.
